{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Build Me Up From Bones; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Folk sounds less appealing than the blues and classic rock I want right now.

ItemID: NA; Title: RAM; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock appeals to me, but I would leave this for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Thick As a Brick 2; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in straightforward songs than a progressive rock concept album today.

ItemID: NA; Title: To All The Girls...; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Country duets could suit my occasional country listening, but I am not drawn enough to choose it today.
